dsp GenBowedViolaGrittyWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.1 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.4 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.009)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3891

bowedCelloSmoothStill.source:
dsp GenBowedCelloSmoothStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.12 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.05
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3932

dsp GenBowedCelloAiryStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.12 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.4) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.18
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.4267

bowedCelloAiryWarm.source:
dsp GenBowedCelloAiryWarm where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.12 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.2 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.4) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.18
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.4261

dsp GenBowedCelloGrittyWarm where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.12 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.2 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3930

bowedCelloGrittyWide.source:
dsp GenBowedCelloGrittyWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.12 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.4 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.009)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3909

bowedBassAiryStill.source:
dsp GenBowedBassAiryStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.16 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.4) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.18
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.25 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.4264

bowedBassAiryWarm.source:
dsp GenBowedBassAiryWarm where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.16 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.2 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.4) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.18
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.25 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.4259

bowedBassGrittyWarm.source:
dsp GenBowedBassGrittyWarm where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.16 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.2 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.25 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3944

bowedBassGrittyWide.source:
dsp GenBowedBassGrittyWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.16 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.4 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.009)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.25 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3939

bowedFiddleSmoothWide.source:
dsp GenBowedFiddleSmoothWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.4 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.009)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.05
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.7 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3910

bowedFiddleAiryStill.source:
dsp GenBowedFiddleAiryStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.4) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.18
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.7 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.4275

bowedFiddleGrittyWarm.source:
dsp GenBowedFiddleGrittyWarm where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.2 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.7 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3909

dsp GenBowedFiddleGrittyWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.4 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.009)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.7 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3879

dsp GenBlownFlutePureLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.5) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.9853

dsp GenBlownFluteBreathyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.12 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.5) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.048) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.8377

dsp GenBlownFluteWindyLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.3 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.5) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.12) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7403

dsp GenBlownFluteWindyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.3 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.5) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.12) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7582

dsp GenBlownRecorderPureLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.45) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.0330

dsp GenBlownRecorderPureHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.45) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.9271

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.9540

dsp GenBlownPanPureLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.55) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.9432

dsp GenBlownPanPureHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.55) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.8290

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.12 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.55) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.048) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.8883

blownPanBreathyHigh.source:
dsp GenBlownPanBreathyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.12 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.55) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.048) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.8027
